column3: Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) — managed Kubernetes cluster
Microsoft Azure Container Registry (ACR) — managed Docker registry
Microsoft Azure SQL Database — managed relational database (PaaS)
Microsoft Azure Cache for Redis — managed Redis cache
Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB — globally distributed multi-model NoSQL database
Microsoft Azure Functions — serverless compute (events + HTTP triggers)
Microsoft Azure App Service — managed web/API host (PaaS)
Microsoft Azure Front Door — global L7 load balancer with WAF
Microsoft Azure Service Bus — enterprise messaging broker (queues + topics)
Microsoft Azure Key Vault — managed secrets / keys / certificates
Microsoft Azure Monitor — logs + metrics + traces (observability)
Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) — identity + workload identity
Microsoft Azure Virtual Machine — managed VM (IaaS)
Microsoft Azure Blob Storage — object storage
Microsoft Azure Machine Learning — managed ML platform (workspaces, training, deployment)
Microsoft Azure DDoS Protection — managed L3/L4 mitigation
